good_thing: (Boston, Massachusetts): The Corey C. Griffin Foundation’s annual back-to-school event gave more than 4,000 children backpacks filled with school supplies on August 19. Families gathered at Dorchester Park for the giveaway, along with games, food, and partner organizations.
current_or_history: On August 23, 1966, NASA’s Lunar Orbiter 1 captured the first image of Earth from lunar orbit as Earth rose above the Moon’s farside. The shot was not originally planned: an issue with film processing left extra exposures, allowing mission managers to turn the spacecraft’s camera toward its direction of travel.
tiny_fact: Octopuses have three hearts: two send oxygen-depleted blood through the gills, while the third pumps oxygenated blood around the body. Their blood is blue because it uses copper-containing hemocyanin rather than hemoglobin.
thought: A small kindness still counts, even when nobody turns it into a headline.
